limitations: Concept presence is a source review lead, not a financial-risk conclusion, current substantial doubt, default, bankruptcy, prediction or trading signal.
False is the filer-reported value in one context, not no financial risk; separate issuer CIKs and contexts are never propagated or merged.

Narrative and specific strings are uninterpreted. Whole text, persons, amounts, contact details and raw DIM segment strings remain private. Verbatim context IDs may contain member-like company cues; those cues are not verified QName or identity mappings.
ddate/qtrs are prepared context fields, not verified exact duration boundaries or knowledge time. Context IDs and filename-like cues must not be parsed into event dates.
A historical context can include later management plans or events; no backdating to its reported period is permitted. Filing date, local verification and event/first-public dates are distinct.
Original documents and exact dimension QName semantics are not verified by this prepared-source projection; no original-source or accounting-comparability qualification is claimed.
Scoped absence excludes custom tags, other concepts/versions, untagged text and other batches. It does not mean no substantial doubt or no financial risk.
Multiple contexts can repeat or dimension a disclosure; records are not unique events. No event deduplication or issuer-wide consolidation occurs.
Official prepared archive is the verified source citation. Constructed SEC accession searches are unfetched and not verified original-filing links.
